thesis: Grief is not the absence of the person, but the presence of the love that has nowhere to go, and you learn to carry it by letting it change shape.

anchor_object.name: folded sweater
anchor_object.initial_state: neatly folded on the chair, untouched
anchor_object.final_state: worn to the door, held in your hands

monologue: Grief isn't the hole they left. It's the love with no address. You fold the sweater, then refold it. You press the sweater to your chest. you can hold. Not to put down, but to carry differently. So you wear it to the door. The sweater has gone cold. You walk with it, and it walks with you.
